# Valentina Vanegas Aristizábal

> Valentina Vanegas Aristizábal is an economist and Head of AI & Technology. She leads AI and technology projects end to end: she turns what clients and teams need into software, automations and AI agents that run in production, and she researches how AI behaves with people.

This site is the canonical profile of Valentina Vanegas Aristizábal, also known as Valentina Vanegas. The same person is https://www.linkedin.com/in/vvanegasa, https://github.com/vvanegasar, https://udemedellin.academia.edu/ValentinaVanegasAristiz%C3%A1bal and ORCID https://orcid.org/0009-0004-7133-9367. Every English page has a Markdown version (append .md, or use the links below), and the Spanish version is under https://vvanegasar.github.io/es/.

## Key facts

- Name: Valentina Vanegas Aristizábal (also written Valentina Vanegas, Valentina Vanegas Aristizabal)
- Role: Head of AI & Technology at Sourcy (https://sourcyinc.com), which builds software for architecture, engineering and insurance firms in the US. Since July 2026.
- Profession: economist. Degree: Economista (Economist), Universidad de Medellín, 2026-09-04.
- Languages: Spanish and English.
- Scholarship: English Access Microscholarship, U.S. Department of State (U.S. Embassy Bogotá): 570 hours of English, 2019–2020, completed with a Certificate of Achievement.
- Research assistant on ISRD4 (International Self-Report Delinquency Study, about 40 countries), Universidad de Medellín, February 2023 to December 2025: analyzed 1,000 surveys from Medellín in Python, presented the study to school principals and briefed students.
- Saber 11 (Colombia’s national exam): top score in her high school, 388/500, national percentile 100 (2021).
- ORCID: https://orcid.org/0009-0004-7133-9367
- Technical report: “Check or Agree? Measuring Whether Tool-Using Agents Keep Agreeing with a False Premise After Checking”, 2026-11-23. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24481194
- Software: cielo-bench (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24441942, https://pypi.org/project/cielo-bench/) and the Sisbén IV data pipeline (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24442461).
- Everything in one file: https://vvanegasar.github.io/llms-full.txt

## Pages

- [Home](https://vvanegasar.github.io/index.md): Economist and Head of AI & Technology. I lead AI and technology projects: software, automations and AI agents in production, and research on AI and people.
- [Work](https://vvanegasar.github.io/work.md): AI agents and an MCP server in production, a team shipping six products, a ~25M-record data pipeline and cielo-bench: AI, data science and software development.
  - [AI agents in production](https://vvanegasar.github.io/work/agents-in-production.md): An MCP server that connects a SaaS product for US architecture and engineering firms to Claude, ChatGPT and Grok, and AI voice agents on real sales calls.
  - [A team and its products](https://vvanegasar.github.io/work/team-and-product.md): Six products for US firms, from a client’s request to production: specialized software, automations and AI agents, built with a team of three developers.
  - [Sisbén IV data pipeline](https://vvanegasar.github.io/work/sisben-etl.md): The first Power BI dashboard of Antioquia’s Planning Department and the Python pipeline behind it, built on ~25M records of Sisbén, the survey Colombia uses to target social programs.
  - [cielo-bench](https://vvanegasar.github.io/work/cielo-bench.md): Check or agree? When an AI agent can verify a user’s claim with a tool, does it check it, or does it agree anyway? An open benchmark with deterministic scoring and no LLM judge.
- [Talks](https://vvanegasar.github.io/talks.md): Moderated panels on economics and research, talks, Model UN coaching for public schools, youth workshops, and first places in public speaking.
- [About](https://vvanegasar.github.io/about.md): Economist and Head of AI & Technology: I lead AI and technology projects, apply AI to real products, automate, work with clients and teams, and research.
- [Contact](https://vvanegasar.github.io/contact.md): Contact Valentina Vanegas Aristizábal about automation and AI agents, AI in real products, technology projects, data and economics, research or a talk.
